definitions.explanation: The period of time when it is light outside, between morning and evening.

examples.japanese: {昼間|ひるま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
{昼間|ひるま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
examples.english: It's very hot during the daytime.

examples.japanese: {昼間|ひるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please call me during the day.

examples.japanese: {昼間|ひるま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{要|い}らない→要る：09589_iru⟧。
examples.english: It's bright during the day, so we don't need the lights.
Sometimes you can see stars even during the day.

notes:
{昼間|ひるま} specifically refers to daylight hours.

TIME OF DAY TERMS:
- {朝|あさ}: morning
- {昼|ひる}: noon, daytime
- {昼間|ひるま}: daytime (emphasizes daylight hours)
- {夕方|ゆうがた}: evening
- {夜|よる}: night
- {夜中|よなか}: middle of the night

{昼|ひる} vs {昼間|ひるま}:
- {昼|ひる}: noon, midday (also used broadly for daytime)
- {昼間|ひるま}: daytime hours (contrasts with nighttime)

OPPOSITE: {夜間|やかん} (nighttime)
